costs.funding_mark_price_fallback: last completed 4h close strictly before fundingTime

trade_rules.signal: At completed 4h close t, close > max(high[t-20..t-1]) for long or close < min(low[t-20..t-1]) for short.
trade_rules.context: BULL when close[t] > EMA50[t] and EMA50[t] > EMA50[t-10]; BEAR when close[t] < EMA50[t] and EMA50[t] < EMA50[t-10]; otherwise TRANSITION.
trade_rules.stop: 1.5 x Wilder ATR(14) from adjusted entry fill.
trade_rules.intrabar_collision: If stop and target are both touched in one 4h bar, assume stop first.
trade_rules.position_policy: One position at a time per symbol; ignore signals while a position is open; skip entries too close to split end to complete horizon.
trade_rules.sizing: 1% of segment equity risk per trade; maximum 3x notional leverage; initial segment equity 10,000 USDT.
